attestations.text: YÜ-ch'ien (Yukien) 裕謙 (T. 衣谷, 魯山, H. 舒亭, known as Yü-t'ai 裕泰 until 1826), 1793–1841, Oct. 11, official, belonged to the Borjigit clan and the Mongol Bordered Yellow Banner. His great-grandfather, Bandi [q. v.], the first Duke Ch'êng-yung (誠勇公 ), committed suicide in 1755 near Ili during the revolt of Amursana [q. v.].
